name: Victory Banner
description:
About This Game

Victory Banner is a fast-paced real-time strategy game featuring third-person direct control over any unit — from infantry to tanks. Experience the pivotal milestones of one of the most significant conflicts in human history, beginning with the events of 1941 on the Eastern Front.

Add the game to your Wishlist and follow us for updates!

Key Features:

  • High-paced сombat: Experience fast and intense interactions on the battlefield, where every moment can be crucial.

  • Instant switching between strategic (RTS) view and third-person direct control: Take command of all unit types — from medics to snipers. Fire mortars and machine guns, take control of tanks, military vehicles, and other equipment. Control entire squads or individual units to directly impact the outcome of battle.

  • Planning. Plan and build defensive fortifications before combat: trenches, bunkers, sandbag barriers, and minefields.

  • Exciting single-player modes and well-crafted historical scenario missions:

- A story-driven mission based on the fighting around the village of Buinichi during the defense of Mogilev in July 1941;

- The replayable Capture mode. Capture, secure, and hold enemy positions before the timer runs out.

  • Detailed maps featuring recognizable Eastern Front environments and other historical locations.

  • Individual inventory for each soldier. Pick up, store, and use a variety of weapons and items: firearms, medkits, grenades, and more.

Feel Like a Strategist

Use the strategic RTS camera view to gain a bird's-eye perspective of the entire map. Assess the battlefield, reconnoiter the terrain, and secure the most advantageous positions for your squads and equipment.

Build fortifications around captured positions: dig trenches, lay antitank barriers and mines, set up sandbags, and more. Deploy troops and soldiers strategically to make full use of the terrain.

Command squads from defensive lines, lead assaults on enemy positions, or defend strategic objectives.

Conduct aerial reconnaissance and call in air or artillery strikes to eliminate enemy clusters and turn the tide of battle at the most critical moment.

Fight on the Frontline

You can instantly switch between controlling entire squads and taking direct command of individual soldiers or vehicles — issue commands or play directly as a specific unit.

Take control yourself:

  • Land a decisive sniper shot — snipers have advantages over other units and are harder for enemies to detect if they stay low and avoid reckless shooting.

  • Break through enemy lines with a tank.

  • As a medic, heal and return a critically wounded soldier to battle.

  • Move your soldier near a commander to gain the “Inspiration” bonus, granting combat advantages.

Make use of all gameplay mechanics on the battlefield: heal wounded soldiers, manage unit inventories, repair damaged vehicles, pick up dropped weapons, and capture enemy vehicles and field guns.

The game features more than 20 controllable units, allowing you to find a solution for almost any combat situation.

Form your squads before and during combat by calling in reinforcements from various unit types:

  • Infantry with a variety of firearms.

  • Specialists like snipers, medics, anti-tank riflemen and others.

  • Armored units including tanks, trucks, and other mechanized units.

  • Portable weaponry like mortars and machine guns.

  • Heavy artillery: field guns, AA machine guns, and more.

The third-person control mode immerses you in dynamic combat where every second demands quick reactions and tactical thinking.

Defend your people, win battles, and become part of a story where every mission is a new chapter of heroism and courage of ordinary men.
short_desc: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of World War II in this real-time historical strategy game. Command a frontline company, make critical strategic decisions, and take direct control of any soldier or vehicle. Every decision comes at a price. What will be yours?
